description: This file defines environment variable macros, external variables, and function prototypes related to Git environment configuration and repository state management.

methods.name: getenv_safe
methods.description: Returns a strdup copy of the environment variable value if it exists.

methods.name: print_sha1_ellipsis
methods.description: Determines if an ellipsis should be printed after abbreviated SHA-1 values.

methods.name: use_optional_locks
methods.description: Returns the boolean value of the GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS environment variable.

methods.name: strip_namespace
methods.description: Removes namespace prefix from a reference string.

methods.name: setup_git_env
methods.description: Sets up environment variables for a given git directory.

methods.name: have_git_dir
methods.description: Checks if a Git repository directory exists.

methods.name: is_bare_repository
methods.description: Determines if the current repository is bare.

methods.name: get_log_output_encoding
methods.description: Returns the encoding used for log output.

methods.name: get_commit_output_encoding
methods.description: Returns the encoding used for commit output.
